question: What is the meaning of ease of recycling in relation to design for recycling?
description: Ease of recycling refers to the design aspect that facilitates the recycling process, making it simpler and more efficient to recover materials from products at the end of their life cycle. This involves using materials that are easily recyclable and ensuring accessible recyclable components, which ultimately supports the circular economy by promoting the reuse and remanufacturing of products.
